subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should OpenClaw accept per-agent managed plugin installs in core now, and what scoped identity/security contract should this PR implement before merge?
rationale: The PR adds a new public CLI and persisted install model across plugin lifecycle and security boundaries, and the linked canonical issue is already marked as needing product and security review.

options.title: Approve a full scoped install contract first
options.body: Define the install-record identity, workspace/global precedence, update/uninstall behavior, docs, restart semantics, and trust policy, then revise this PR to match it.

options.title: Pause this branch behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97749 as the design owner and avoid merging partial scoped install storage until maintainers settle the contract.

options.title: Reject core support for now
options.body: Close or redirect the feature if maintainers decide per-agent plugin installation should remain outside core managed installs for now.

recommendation.title: Approve a full scoped install contract first
recommendation.body: Define the install-record identity, workspace/global precedence, update/uninstall behavior, docs, restart semantics, and trust policy, then revise this PR to match it.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent history on managed plugin install records, recovery, registry refresh, and uninstall teardown points to this owner for the contract decision.
